scope.duration: One finite positive integer multiple of 60 seconds, no greater than 7200 seconds, ceil-rounded from launch time to end at or just after 2026-10-16T03:21:00Z.
scope.output: New unique private evidence path; retain original completed observation.
scope.authorization_note: This is technical review of the requested passive observation, not authority for source changes, signals, restarts, profiler attachment or broader monitoring.

verified_controls.finding: Expected ps start/command checked before startup; full PID/parent/start/command compared immediately before and after every accounting read. Kernel UUID/start must remain stable and exit timestamp must be zero; mismatch stops and records error.

ABI inputs hash-bound and every ctypes field offset/size/alignment matched to public SDK structure. Only proc_pid_rusage flavor 0 through libproc is called; failed call records error and has no fallback.
Evidence path exclusively reserved; bounded accounting samples are atomically saved. No restart, launchd mutation, task attachment, suspension, target signal or profiler fallback exists.

limits: Accounting samples cannot attribute allocator stacks or prove a leak.
Interval NaN/Inf validation is a pre-existing parser limitation outside this approved literal 60-second invocation.

The unchanged ps subprocess has a 5-second timeout; standard-library timeout cleanup may kill its own ps helper. It does not signal the observed perception process. No target-control operation is authorized or present.
Timing can finish slightly after nominal target due to scheduling and identity-read latency.
